summary: Typosquat of noblox.js drops and executes remote Windows binary on install
details: noblox-asset.js is a typosquat of the legitimate noblox.js Roblox API wrapper (repository, homepage, and author fields are copied verbatim from the upstream package). package.json registers `postinstall: node postinstall.mjs`, which runs automatically on `npm install`. postinstall.mjs is a heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io string-array with rotation and wrapper decoders `_0x17c128`/`_0x23aa95`/`_0x1cc925`) ~85KB script whose decoded behavior downloads `TRLX.exe` from a `*.netlify.app` subdomain, writes it into the user's home directory, and spawns hidden PowerShell (`windowsHide:true`) to execute and persist it. There is no hash pinning, no publisher-matching source, and no relationship between an opaque Windows executable and the advertised Roblox library purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
